notes.title: Big Fall Update
notes.content:
🚀 Exciting New Update for "The Cable Guy"! 🌟

Hello Cable Guy Players!

We’re thrilled to announce that a brand new update for The Cable Guy is just around the corner, bringing fresh features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what's coming:

🎮 New Game Mode:
Get ready for an all-new game mode! Challenge yourself in a whole new way and discover exciting twists in the gameplay you love.

🌍 Spanish Localization:
¡Hola! We're expanding! The game is now fully translated into Spanish, allowing even more players to enjoy The Cable Guy in their preferred language.

🖥️ UI Improvements:
We've polished the user interface for a smoother, more intuitive experience, making it even easier to navigate the game.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Crash Resolutions:
As always, we've been hard at work squashing bugs and fixing crashes to ensure a more stable gaming experience.

Update your game as soon as it drops, and dive into all the new content and improvements!

Thank you for your ongoing support,
The Cable Guy Team 🎉

notes.title: April Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44461287/92ec6eace012c16d7bf76800c9058a900952095e.jpg[/img]
Hello everybody. Today we are making some cool updates to the game. Here they are:
- Added the ability to start the map with a predefined seed. You can see the seed of the current map in the pause menu and copy it from there.
- Now you can see not just the place of the last Daily Challenge you participated in but also the results table. We think it is always interesting to see 🙂
- Now event menu shows if the new server room is going to spawn so there wouldn't be any surprises here.
- While you are playing the level music will shuffle through the playlist now.
As usual, we have several bug fixes;

Enjoy 🙂

notes.title: Update March, 7th
notes.content:
In this patch, our primary focus was on enhancing stability and performance. Several improvements and optimizations have been implemented to address crashes, although not all issues may be resolved. Still, the switching to DirectX11 remains a workaround in some cases. So, we continue to work on this.

Upon the first launch, the game will conduct an internal benchmark to automatically configure optimal graphics settings. We've tuned visuals for low-spec PCs to ensure a smoother experience.

Additional Fixes and Improvements:

[list]
[*] Corrected music interruptions during gameplay
[*] Restored the missing Exit button in photo mode
[*] Introduced a couple of new weekend events
[*] Resolved various animation issues
[*] Expanded zoom levels for better visibility
[*] Implemented several quality-of-life improvements
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support as we work to refine and enhance your gaming experience.

tags.bug: [*] Restored the missing Exit button in photo mode

tags.feature: [*] Introduced a couple of new weekend events
[*] Expanded zoom levels for better visibility

notes.title: Selling stuff for full price
notes.content:
First of all thank you all who played our demo.
You left a lot of comments about ways you would like for the game to improve in and we tried to accomodate as many as we could. 
It seems that alot of you disliked the fact that selling stuff retunes only 50% of the value. This feature was added early in the development as the inflation tool and a the way to add more pressure on the player but turned out that it feels unfair for the newer players and a bit inconsequential for the more seasoned ones. So we removed it :) 
Not just it - here is the list with some of the changes we made in the last couple of weeks:
- new score model implemented
- reworked economy system
- added new cursors
- implemented some additional options to help you customize your experience. Like ability to switch between drag and point and click modes for building wires and dark theme for the tractical mode
- auto-saves
- photomode :)
- new music tracks
and some more 
Feel free to try it in the new demo build and share your thoughts
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44461287/0f45974cb45b9b37251f282e67ab2fd83843debd.png[/img]
